runs.command:
@report="$$($(INTERROGATE) $(FLAGS) $(INTERROGATE_TARGETS))"; \
  status=$$?; \
  printf '%s\n' "$$report"; \
  test "$$status" -eq 0 || exit "$$status"; \
  if printf '%s\n' "$$report" | grep -q '| *MISSED |'; then exit 1; fi
